definitions.gloss: the first score of the game
definitions.explanation: the initial point, goal, or run scored in a competitive match

examples.japanese: {先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧10{分|ぷん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: They scored the opening goal at 10 minutes in the first half.

examples.japanese: {先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われた→奪う：01895_ubau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いついた。
examples.english: They conceded the first goal but caught up in the second half.

notes:
SPORTS TERM:
{先制点|せんせいてん} combines {先制|せんせい} (taking the initiative) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point/score). Used across various sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧/⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ - to score first
- {先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧ - to snatch the opening score
- {先制点|せんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧/⟦{奪|うば}われる→奪う：01895_ubau⟧ - to concede the first score

IMPORTANCE:
In many sports, the team that scores {先制点|せんせいてん} has a psychological advantage and often wins the game.

RELATED WORDS:
- {追加点|ついかてん} - additional score
- ⟦{同点|どうてん}→同点：08586_douten⟧ - tie score
- {決勝点|けっしょうてん} - winning/deciding score
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ - reversal/comeback
